scenarios.rationale: Unknown username, unmapped user, user without email, getUserById 404 and wrong password all return a byte-identical 401 (asserted in route.test).

scenarios.scenario: Timing oracle between unknown username and wrong password
scenarios.rationale: Mitigated: both paths do one getUserById and one signInWithPassword. Residual difference (different GoTrue paths) accepted known-gap; not measured.

scenarios.scenario: Self-signup email account logs in via username route
scenarios.rationale: No public.usernames row (writes are service_role only), so it takes the unmapped path -> 401. Hosted confirmation is AC8 (owner).
Origin header must equal getSiteOrigin() else 403 (no-store, no cookie); missing Origin also 403.

scenarios.scenario: Service-role or publishable key exposure / secret logging
scenarios.rationale: Service key read only server-side and never returned or logged; dummy client uses publishable key only; logs contain only fixed reason codes; tests assert no username/password/email/user_id in console calls.

scenarios.scenario: Session cookie leak on failure or via dummy client
scenarios.rationale: Dummy client is plain supabase-js with persistSession false (never createRouteClient); on sign-in error a fresh response is returned; tests assert no set-cookie on 400/401/403/503. Cookie flags come from the existing enforceHttpOnlyCookieOptions policy (HttpOnly).

scenarios.scenario: Brute force / shared egress rate bucket lockout
scenarios.rationale: Accepted known-gap RL1; 429 maps to 503. Backlog: process/general-plans/backlog/username-login-rate-limit_NOTE_18-11-26.md
